senses.gloss:
उत्फल् {c1c} P.
1 To spring, leap.
--2 To part asunder, expand, open (as
a flower). --Caus. To open, cause to
expand.

1 A jump, spring,
leaping up; rapid motion; Mk. 6.
--2
Shuffling of feet.
--3 The jumping
attitude.

उत्फुल्ल p. p. [उद्-फल्-क्त]
1
Opened, full blown (as flowers);
उत्फुल्लनीलनलिनोदरतुल्यभासः Śi. 11. 36.
--2 Widely opened, expanded,
dilated (eyes); विस्मय ˚नयनः Pt. 1.
--3
Swollen, increased in bulk.
--4
Sleeping supinely or on the back;
cf. उत्तान.
--ल्लं
1 The female organ of
generation (स्त्रीकरणं).
--2 A kind of
coitus.
